home_hero_paragraph:
Two places. Two moods. One single invitation: to make the most of Spain.
A casa full of charm near the Mar Menor and a peaceful penthouse overlooking the golf course.
Two family-run addresses in the heart of the Costa Cálida.
home_intro_title_em: To give you an unforgettable holiday
home_intro_p1: Picture your next holiday under the Spanish sun…
home_intro_p2: On one side, sea air, the beach a short walk away and that feeling of freedom the moment you wake up. On the other, quiet, a terrace looking over the golf course, and sunsets that make you wish the day would never end.
home_intro_p3: Casa DaNa or Casa CasAy? Two different worlds, one shared aim: to give you the break you wait for all year.
home_intro_p4: All that's left is choosing your mood… We'll take care of the setting. The memories are yours to make.
home_story_title_em: and one shared wish: to host you differently
home_story_p1: It all started with Casa DaNa. A house designed as a real place to live in: family moments, meals that stretch on, sunshine, a roof terrace, and that Spanish way of living we wanted to share.
home_story_p2: Then came Casa CasAy, born of a different wish: to offer somewhere quieter, facing the golf course, with a pool and that sense of switching off we all look for on holiday.
home_story_p3: Today, these two addresses tell a little of our story.
home_story_p4: And above all, we've chosen to stay close to our guests.
home_story_p5: No large, impersonal agency here, and no middlemen at every step. You book directly with us, the owners. When you write to us, it really is us who answer.
home_story_p6: We know every room, every terrace, every detail of our homes… because we chose, furnished and prepared them ourselves, with care.
home_story_p7: Casa DaNa & Casa CasAy aren't simply two holiday rentals. They're two places we love, and that we decided to share with you.
home_story_closing: Two places… one single promise: an unforgettable holiday.

prop_casadana_lead: Your break in the sun, between easy living and sea air.
prop_casadana_p1: Designed to host up to 6 guests, Casa DaNa invites you to make the most of Spain, just 1.6 km from the Mar Menor.
prop_casadana_p2: Here, days begin gently, stretch on around a good meal, and end up on the private solarium, unwinding in the jacuzzi under the Spanish sky.
prop_casadana_p3: A warm house, made for coming together, slowing down, enjoying… and leaving with far more than just photos.
prop_casadana_p4: Casa DaNa is the kind of place where a holiday turns into real memories.
prop_casacasay_lead: Quiet, space, and easy living under the Spanish sun.
prop_casacasay_p1: Perched on the 3rd floor of a secure community, Casa CasAy is an elegant 70 m² apartment made for those who like a peaceful holiday, away from the bustle.
prop_casacasay_p2: Its large terrace, open onto the fairway, offers an uninterrupted view — ideal for breakfasts in the sun, long summer evenings, or simply a few hours doing nothing at all.
prop_casacasay_p3: Just 15 minutes from the sea, you get the best of both worlds here: the quiet of the golf course, and the Mediterranean within easy reach.
prop_casacasay_p4: Casa CasAy is that sunlit break where you slow down, you breathe… and you'd rather not leave.
casadana_description: Discover our charming Spanish rental house in Los Alcázares, perfect for accommodating up to six people. Just 1.6 km from the beach, you'll find plenty of activities nearby to enhance your stay.
casadana_checklist_sixth: A town not overcrowded with tourists
casadana_gallery_description: Every room is designed with an editorial eye, blending local textures with modern luxury.
casadana_about_title: Refined Living on the Mar Menor
casadana_experiences_description: From high-speed thrills to serene maritime journeys, the Mar Menor offers activities for every soul.
casadana_local_area_description: Los Alcázares is more than a destination; it's a sensory experience. From the therapeutic waters of the Mar Menor to the hidden thermal springs of Archena, discover a region where history and wellness converge.
casadana_los_alcazares_description: Los Alcázares, a charming village nestled in the heart of Spain, enchants with its authenticity and warm atmosphere. Surrounded by picturesque landscapes, this haven of peace offers a perfect blend of tradition and modernity. With its quaint streets, local markets, and proximity to the beach (Mar Menor), Los Alcázares is an ideal destination for lovers of culture, nature, and relaxation.
casacasay_description:
Welcome to Casa CasAy, an elegant 104 m² penthouse designed for your comfort and relaxation. Nestled in a secure gated community, it offers a superb terrace with breathtaking views of the golf course, ideal for savoring every moment in complete serenity.
Perfect for accommodating up to 4 people, this haven of tranquility is located just 15 minutes from the Mar Menor and Los Alcázares, where you will also find Casa DaNa.
Let yourself be seduced by a place where comfort, calm and sunshine come together to create unforgettable memories.

villa_casadana_ribbon_4: Calm waters of the Mar Menor
villa_casadana_about_lead: At Casa DaNa, you slow down, you enjoy, and you savour every moment.
villa_casadana_about_body: Tucked into a quiet neighbourhood of Los Alcázares, just 1.6 km from the Mar Menor, this house welcomes up to 6 guests in a warm, sunlit setting.
villa_casadana_about_body_2: Two bedrooms, two terraces, a private solarium and a jacuzzi: everything is here for good times with family or friends.
villa_casadana_about_body_3: The charm of the south, with the quiet added in.
villa_casadana_gallery_description: Each piece is designed with an editorial eye, blending local textures with understated, modern luxury. Touch a piece to explore its full gallery.
villa_casadana_local_area_description: Los Alcázares is more than a destination; it's a sensory experience. From the therapeutic waters of the Mar Menor to the hidden thermal springs of Archena, this is a region where history and well-being still dictate the rhythm of the day.
villa_casadana_local_area_point_1_descri: Stroll among the Roman thermal ruins and along the seafront. Tapas, Tuesday market and salty mornings.
villa_casadana_local_area_point_2_descri: A 40-minute drive inland, the famous Roman thermal spa is nestled in the Ricote Valley.
villa_casadana_local_area_point_3_descri: Sail to the lighthouse, dive in the marine reserve, dine on the narrow strip between two seas.
villa_casadana_local_area_point_4_descri: Baroque cathedral, the casino, late-night terraces on the Plaza de las Flores.
villa_casadana_local_area_point_5_descri: Direct flights from London, Manchester, Paris and Brussels.
villa_casadana_experiences_description: From high-speed thrills to serene sea voyages, the Mar Menor offers something for everyone. Our concierge service will help you book any of these activities.
villa_casadana_experiences_1_description: Professional slopes for the ultimate adrenaline rush, just minutes from the villa.
villa_casadana_experiences_2_description: Enjoy the coastal breeze on the calm, shallow and inviting waters of the inland sea.
villa_casadana_experiences_3_description: Water slides, lazy rivers and wave pools — a perfect family day out under the Murcian sun.
villa_casadana_experiences_4_description: Paddle through the hidden coves and silent shores of the Mar Menor at your own pace.
villa_casadana_reviews_description: Reviews gathered on Airbnb, Booking and direct booking. We keep them all — the sunrise on the roof comes up often.
villa_casadana_faq_intro: A few quick answers — for the rest, write to us directly and we will reply within a few hours.
villa_casadana_faq_1_answer: Three nights in low season (Oct.–May) and six nights in high season (June–Sept.).
villa_casadana_faq_2_question: How does the arrival process unfold?
villa_casadana_faq_2_answer: Check-in between 4 pm and 10 pm. Please contact our concierge 30 minutes before you arrive.
villa_casadana_faq_4_answer: Full refund up to 30 days before arrival. After that, no refund.
villa_casadana_cta_strip_tail: They are waiting for you at Casa DaNa.
villa_casadana_sister_description: Casa CasAy is our two-bedroom penthouse in a secure residence, fifteen minutes inland — large south-facing terrace, shared pool, unobstructed views of the golf course. Same hosts, same service.
villa_casacasay_ribbon_5: 30 minutes from the center of Murcia
villa_casacasay_about_lead: At Casa CasAy, the holiday settles into a gentler rhythm.
villa_casacasay_about_body: This 70 m² penthouse, set in a secure community, opens onto a large south-facing terrace with uninterrupted golf views — ideal for breakfasts in the sun and long, quiet evenings.
villa_casacasay_about_body_2: With its two bedrooms and peaceful feel, it's the perfect base for couples, friends or small families after some quiet — while staying just 15 minutes from the sea.
villa_casacasay_about_body_3: A different pace of holiday, quite simply.
villa_casacasay_gallery_description: Twenty-three photographs of the penthouse: the living spaces, the bedrooms, and the terrace looking onto the green. Write to us if there is a detail you would like to see.
villa_casacasay_gallery_img_living_3: From the living room to the kitchen
villa_casacasay_local_area_description: A short drive between the salt flats, the village, and the sea—but with the tranquility of the inland valleys. Spend your mornings on the terrace, drive to the Mar Menor for lunch, and return for sunset on the green.
villa_casacasay_local_area_point_1_descr: The seaside village, the inland sea, our sister property Casa DaNa.
villa_casacasay_local_area_point_2_descr: Baroque cathedral, casino, late-night terraces on the Plaza de las Flores.
villa_casacasay_local_area_point_3_descr: Famous Roman thermal spa nestled in the Ricote Valley.
villa_casacasay_local_area_point_4_descr: Direct flights from London, Manchester, Paris and Brussels.
villa_casacasay_reviews_description: Verified stays only. The terrace at golden hour and the tranquility are frequently mentioned.
villa_casacasay_cta_strip_tail: — Your week starts at Casa CasAy.
villa_casacasay_sister_description: Casa DaNa is our family-run guesthouse for six people in Los Alcázares itself — rooftop solarium, jacuzzi, and 1.6 km from the Mar Menor. Same hosts, same care.
